purpose: Machine-readable source, coverage, temporality, and release-gate register for the four-sport all-role project.
legal_disclaimer: The green/amber/red labels are conservative project-governance decisions, not legal advice.

posture_legend.green: An explicit license supports the stated use when its attribution and other conditions are followed.
posture_legend.amber: Local research is supportable only within stated conditions, or the upstream rights chain is not sufficiently clear for raw redistribution or commercial use.
posture_legend.red: Do not use for a release model, redistribute, or commercialize without written permission, a licensed replacement, or a documented rights review.

study_window.competition_scope: Regular season only. EPL means Premier League, not UEFA Champions League.

provenance_authority.rule: The per-file sidecar is authoritative for the exact URL, retrieval time, SHA-256, byte count, and source note. Regenerate the central manifest after any acquisition before publishing a snapshot.

nfl.count_note: Hardened snapshot using the season-modal specific weekly depth-chart role. Snapshot counts are not a stable API contract; rebuilds can change them.

nba.count_note: All-role counts are confirmed regular-season appearance rows and therefore differ from the broader 2,932-row canonical roster/profile panel.

nhl.count_note: Appearance-based skaters and goalies; not a complete zero-game contract roster.

epl.count_note: Only broad FPL roles are retained. Current ESPN profile matches are sparse and are not historical measurements.

role_feasibility.supported: The listed broad roles are feasible from roster and depth-chart labels. OLB is grouped with EDGE as an explicit broad-taxonomy assumption.
role_feasibility.withheld: Generic DB, DL, and OL labels are not guessed. Slot/outside corner, box/deep safety, rush/coverage linebacker, route, and blocking-assignment roles require licensed charting or tracking.
role_feasibility.abstention: OT, IOL, and LS identities remain in the roster-inclusive panel, but the hardened runtime assigns them no performance opportunity or label and fits no performance models for them.

key_fields_consumed: credited sacks, QB hits, interceptions, forced fumbles, passes defended, tackles, and negative-play tackles
sources.license_basis: nflverse-data is distributed under CC BY 4.0; retain nflverse and applicable provider attribution and do not imply ownership of third-party marks.
sources.conditions: Attribution is mandatory. A commercial release still needs a source-chain, trademark, and product-terms review.

key_fields_consumed: paired play type, no-play flag, down, defense team, dropback, rush, and scramble flags
sources.provider_split: NFL NextGenStats via nflverse through 2022; FTN Data via nflverse from 2023 onward.
sources.license_basis: CC BY-SA 4.0 with provider attribution; share-alike obligations apply to covered derivatives.
sources.conditions: Resolve how CC BY-SA applies to distributed models and applications before release; preserve NGS/FTN-via-nflverse attribution and the provider-era flag.

sources.v1_usage: Cached source inventory only. The hardened all-role runtime and model training do not load PFR-derived snap counts, advanced defense, or combine fields. OT/IOL/LS identities are retained from roster data and abstain from performance modeling.
key_fields_inventoried: combine height, weight, arm length, hand size, 40-yard dash, 10-yard split, vertical, broad jump, three-cone, shuttle, and bench
sources.license_basis: PFR-derived conditional enrichment. The cached source note requires Sports Reference AI/ML and reuse review.
sources.conditions: Excluded from all-role runtime, labels, features, denominators, and model training. Reconsider only after a documented rights review or replacement with a cleared source.

sources.seasons: historical prospect tests; not annual player-season measurements
sources.license_basis: No clear data reuse license was found for the dataset at retrieval.
sources.conditions: Keep out of learned features until the dataset license and upstream rights are documented.

physical_coverage_and_temporality.default_source: Earliest archived weekly roster listing within each season.
physical_coverage_and_temporality.measurement_status: Season-attached roster listing; actual measurement date and protocol are unknown. It is not a verified annual body test.
physical_coverage_and_temporality.optional_testing_status: Combine/pro-day tests are dated historical events, often years before a modeled season. Test year and protocol must travel with every value.
physical_coverage_and_temporality.known_gaps: Arm/hand measures have much broader coverage than wingspan; there is no general leg-length source.

gates.scope: Local research for core offense, defense, kicking, and punting roles using cleared nflverse core plus correctly attributed participation.

OT, IOL, and LS retain roster identity and build fields only. Do not emit observed performance, native forecasts, or target-role performance heads without a release-safe individual label and complete denominator.
Train on PFR-derived advanced/combine data or array-carpenter testing until rights are cleared.
Publish participation-derived models only after CC BY-SA obligations and NGS/FTN attribution are implemented.

nba.canonical_id: ESPN athlete_id represented as a string

role_feasibility.supported: Broad guard, forward/wing, and center/interior-big cohorts are stable enough for v1.
role_feasibility.withheld: PG/SG/SF/PF, primary-handler, wing-stopper, rim-protector, and matchup roles are not treated as reliable longitudinal labels from the cached profile and box-score sources.
role_feasibility.missing_data_domain: The cache has no league-wide deflections, charges drawn, loose balls recovered, contested shots, matchup possessions, top speed, or player tracking.

key_fields_consumed: field goals, three-pointers, free throws, points
assists, turnovers, offensive/defensive rebounds, steals, blocks, fouls, plus_minus
sources.license_basis: SportsDataverse publicly packages ESPN-derived release assets. A repository or packaging license does not resolve ownership and reuse rights in the underlying ESPN/NBA data.
sources.conditions: Use for reproducible local research/prototyping; perform an upstream rights review before sharing row-level data, trained artifacts that embed protected data, or a commercial service.

sources.v1_usage: Optional identifier enrichment only; ESPN athlete_id remains canonical and the all-role output does not require this crosswalk.
sources.coverage_note: Current-season enrichment with incomplete historical-player coverage.
sources.license_basis: Underlying provider identifiers retain their upstream rights.

physical_coverage_and_temporality.coverage: Complete in the current all-role panel.
physical_coverage_and_temporality.measurement_status: Historical player_core files were regenerated from current ESPN profiles. Height and weight are current/undated profile values, not annual measurements.

gates.scope: Local broad-role research using guard/forward/center and transparent box-score rate composites.
Claim annual weight change or physical development from repeated current-profile values.
Train granular defensive-role or tracking models without a licensed, season-dated tracking/hustle source.
Redistribute cached ESPN-derived row-level data or commercialize the model before upstream rights review.

role_feasibility.supported: C, L/LW, R/RW, D, and G map directly to the five v1 roles.
role_feasibility.withheld: Line number, handed side deployment, shutdown/transition role, special-team unit, defense pairing, and goalie style require additional shift, lineup, or tracking data.

sources.grain: provider season-summary rows by player, team, and situation; the builder selects situation=all and collapses team stints
sources.license_basis: MoneyPuck permits noncommercial use and ad-hoc journalism with clear attribution; other uses require contact and approval.
sources.conditions: Credit MoneyPuck clearly. Do not scrape undesignated pages. Obtain permission for commercial or other unlisted uses.

sources.grain: provider season-summary rows by goalie, team, and situation; the builder selects situation=all and collapses team stints
sources.semantic_warning: The source has actual rebounds but no rebound-goal field. rebound_rate is rebounds divided by saves. The legacy rebound_goals_against_rate output is an identical alias and must not be described as rebound goals against.
sources.license_basis: Same MoneyPuck noncommercial and attribution conditions as the skater downloads.

sources.v1_usage: Used by the base possession pipeline and QA, not by the all-role season-summary builder.
Goalie physical/profile enrichment and NHL fallback profile data.

sources.measurement_status: The query selects a season-filtered player universe, but the returned profile values are current/undated and are not confirmed measurements from that season.
sources.license_basis: Official NHL statistics and marks remain subject to NHL terms; no general open-data redistribution grant is asserted by this project.

physical_coverage_and_temporality.coverage: 5,257 of 5,263 current all-role rows have height and weight.
physical_coverage_and_temporality.measurement_status: Every row is explicitly marked physical_is_confirmed_season_measurement=false. Skater bios and goalie lookup values are current/undated profiles.

gates.scope: Local noncommercial all-role research for skaters and goalies with clear MoneyPuck attribution.
Public derived work only after confirming MoneyPuck attribution/display requirements and excluding raw-file redistribution.
Commercial model or portal use without MoneyPuck permission and an NHL source/marks review.
Interpret repeated height/weight as annual measurements or the legacy rebound_goals_against_rate alias as actual rebound goals.
The current 224-file central download manifest includes all five designated 2021-2025 MoneyPuck goalie summaries and their sidecar provenance.

epl.canonical_id: Stable FPL player code prefixed with fpl:

role_feasibility.supported: Only the broad Fantasy Premier League labels GK, DEF, MID, and FWD are supported in v1.
role_feasibility.withheld: Current five-season caches do not provide reliable longitudinal CB, fullback, wingback, defensive/central/attacking midfield, wing, second-striker, or center-forward labels.
role_feasibility.hard_gate: A recent granular EPL role model requires a licensed lineup/event or tracking source with dated position/deployment labels. Do not infer granular ground truth from broad FPL roles.

sources.license_basis: The repository software is MIT licensed, while its license notice says the underlying data belong to Fantasy Premier League and Understat. The software license is not treated as a data-rights grant.
sources.conditions: Attribute the community archive and review FPL/Understat terms before any release.

sources.coverage_warning: The existing audit found 293 missing block values among 11,492 enhanced player-match rows. Fifty-one players had a mixture of observed and missing block values, 22 had every observed-appearance block value missing, and eight eligible defenders reached the earlier unified cohort with affected season totals. Present numeric season totals are not automatically complete totals.
sources.license_basis: No repository data license was found at retrieval and underlying provider rights are unclear.
sources.conditions: Do not use as the all-role training target until reuse rights and metric-specific completeness are resolved. Schema presence is not sufficient validation for speed or tracking fields.

sources.coverage_note: Current all-role panel: 1,398 of 4,005 rows have both height and weight. Matching is name/team based and unresolved or fuzzy cases require review.
sources.measurement_status: Profile snapshot retrieved after 2025-26. Values are current/undated and are not asserted as historical season measurements even when propagated to earlier stable identities.
sources.license_basis: Public site JSON without an asserted open-data license.
sources.conditions: Retain retrieval date and match confidence; review ESPN and upstream terms before release.

physical_coverage_and_temporality.coverage: 1,398 of 4,005 all-role rows have both height and weight; age is present for 2,109 rows.
physical_coverage_and_temporality.measurement_status: The ESPN values are a current/undated profile snapshot, not annual measurements. Vaastav birth dates provide age for additional rows but no historical body dimensions.
unaccepted_as_features: sprint count from the unlicensed enhanced source

gates.scope: Local broad-role v1 prototype using only GK/DEF/MID/FWD and transparent FPL-derived outcome proxies.
Build or describe recent granular CB/FB/WB/DM/CM/AM/wing/striker models from the current cache. A licensed source is required.
Use the FPL-Core enhanced defensive or speed fields for release training until rights and metric-specific completeness are resolved.
Claim annual physical change or full physical coverage from the ESPN snapshot.
Redistribute the cached community or ESPN raw files, or commercialize the resulting model, before upstream rights review.

external_soccer_candidates.recommended_use: Historical event-engineering and reproducibility benchmark, including the 2017-18 Premier League; not a source of current EPL truth or a sufficient current granular-role label set.
external_soccer_candidates.coverage: One complete season for La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Premier League, and Ligue 1, plus FIFA World Cup 2018 and UEFA Euro 2016; 1,941 matches, 3,251 players, and roughly three million events are described in the data paper.
key_fields: player foot, height, weight, birth date, and broad role where present
external_soccer_candidates.license_basis: The Figshare Events, Matches, and Players items report CC BY 4.0. Cite the collection and data paper and preserve attribution.
external_soccer_candidates.go_no_go: GO for an explicitly historical benchmark; NO-GO as evidence that a 2025-26 player has a particular granular role or current efficacy.

external_soccer_candidates.recommended_use: Conditional historical event/lineup benchmark after accepting and recording the custom agreement. For recent EPL granular roles, obtain a licensed product feed with the required seasons and position/deployment fields.
key_fields: event JSON with player, team, location, timestamp, type, outcome, and qualifiers
external_soccer_candidates.license_basis: Custom StatsBomb Public Data User Agreement. The repository README says selected leagues are free for public research/genuine interest and requires StatsBomb source attribution and logo use when publishing, sharing, or distributing analysis. The full agreement must be reviewed for the intended use.
external_soccer_candidates.go_no_go: CONDITIONAL for listed open competitions under the recorded terms; NO-GO as a recent EPL source because the open index does not contain recent EPL seasons.

global_go_no_go_gates.decision_rule: GO only when every training source has a sidecar with exact URL, retrieval timestamp, SHA-256, byte count, and source-use note, and the central manifest has been regenerated after the last download.
GO for local research only within each source's stated scope. NO-GO for raw redistribution or commercial use when any required source is amber or red without written clearance.
GO only after canonical IDs are unique at player-season grain, trade/team stints are collapsed without double counting provider total rows, and unresolved joins are quarantined.
GO only when every rate has a documented, complete denominator on the same event scope. Missing exposure is not zero exposure.
GO only for observed role labels with adequate samples. Abstain on unsupported roles; do not infer granular ground truth from broad labels.
GO only after metric-specific completeness checks. A numeric season sum is not complete when some games are missing the metric.
GO for a profile-based association only when measurement timing is disclosed. NO-GO for annual-change claims unless the value has a dated, season-valid measurement and protocol.
GO only with athlete-disjoint and chronological evaluation, a frozen 2025 test season, and no future profile or performance information entering earlier-season training features.

Season-role performance percentiles are acceptable context. A repeated undated physical value may be ranked against each season's cohort but must be labeled a profile percentile, not an annual body measurement.

The unified result may be described as a build-and-transferable-performance analogy or guestimate. NO-GO on calling it a probability of sport-switch success until labeled cross-sport outcomes and external validation exist.

A public portal may expose aggregate/derived results only after source-specific attribution, license compatibility, uncertainty, evidence status, and abstention text are implemented. Never bundle red-source raw data.
